messages:
Maya (Support): Hey team — AcmeCorp says invoice INV-2024-0823 doesn't show their PO# (they supplied PO 789012). Charge already went through. They need an invoice with PO for internal processing. Can we reissue + credit or append PO? Link to PDF: https://invoices.redwood.example/INV-2024-0823.pdf

Jordan (Finance): Do we know if the PO was captured on our side (invoice metadata) or if it was dropped before rendering? If it's in metadata maybe just re-render?

Maya (Support): Quick check in UI shows Purchase Order blank on PDF. Customer emailed a screenshot. I haven't checked DB yet.

Eli (Payments): I can check payment metadata. Quick queries: 
```
-- PG
SELECT metadata->>'purchase_order' FROM invoices WHERE invoice_number='INV-2024-0823';
-- Stripe
stripe invoices retrieve inv_12345 --expand invoice.lines,data
stripe charges retrieve ch_1Jxxxx --expand=invoice
```
I'll run and report.

Maya (Support): thanks. I'm on the thread with customer, telling them we're investigating.

billing-bot: Render job 442: invoice INV-2024-0823 generated by renderer v2.4.0 (template: default-v2). No purchase_order value found in template variables.

Eli (Payments): Results: PG shows metadata.purchase_order = '789012' (so we did capture it). Stripe charge ch_1Jxxxx shows metadata.purchase_order='789012' as well. So pointer: metadata present, PDF rendering omitted it.

Liz (Ops): Hmm, that matches an internal change we deployed last week. Template default-v2 had a refactor that accidentally removed the header block rendering the purchase_order if present. I reverted the template repo to default-v1 on staging but prod still on v2.4.0. Cause identified. :eyes:

Jordan (Finance): Good catch. So two options: 1) re-render the same invoice PDF with PO and send it alongside original PDF (but audit might require credit/rebill because original invoice was already paid), or 2) issue a full credit (credit note / refund) and create a new invoice that includes the PO and re-charge. What's our recommended compliance path?

Eli (Payments): For clients that require exact invoice numbers for PO matching, Finance usually wants a credit+reissue so the new invoice has a fresh number that references the credit. That keeps accounting clean.

Jordan (Finance): Agree. Policy: paid invoice with missing required PO -> full credit + new invoice with PO; attach note referencing original.

Maya (Support): Customer prefers fastest route; they said reissued invoice with PO is fine, they will accept credit+reissue. I'll confirm SLA window.

Liz (Ops): Plan: patch renderer to restore PO block and re-deploy hotfix to prod (minor template rollback). Then create new invoice (INV-2024-0823-R1 or new number as per billing system), generate PDF (verify PO shown), and issue credit note for the original.

Eli (Payments): I'll prepare the refund/credit steps. Stripe path (if using Stripe invoices + payments):
```
# create credit note (if using Stripe invoices):
stripe credit_notes create --invoice inv_12345 --amount 49900 --reason "post_payment_po_missing"
# OR full refund on charge
stripe refunds create --charge ch_1Jxxxx --reason requested_by_customer
```
We should follow accounting direction: create a credit note tied to the invoice so GL entries are clean. Jordan, confirm preference.

Jordan (Finance): Credit note tied to invoice. Use accounting code 4-4200 for credits. New invoice should reference PO 789012 and include a note: "Reissue after missing PO on invoice INV-2024-0823". Also add internal tag `po_fix_reissue` for audit.

Maya (Support): Customer confirmed they want credit+reissue. They asked for ETA.

Eli (Payments): ETA: I can run credit note + new invoice generation in ~45-60 mins once Liz deploys the renderer patch. Steps I'll take: 1) create credit_note in Stripe (link to credit note) 2) create new invoice in billing system with same line items + metadata.purchase_order='789012' 3) re-charge (or send new hosted invoice link) 4) attach new PDF to customer email.

Liz (Ops): Deploying template rollback now to prod — monitoring. Will notify when render job with PO succeeds.

billing-bot: Deploy: template-default-v1 rolled to prod by liz.ops at 2024-07-18T14:02Z. Post-deploy smoke: render test INV-TEST-001 shows PO field present.

Eli (Payments): Patch verified. I created credit note CN-2024-110 for INV-2024-0823 (amount 499.00 USD) and a new invoice INV-2024-0823-R1 created in billing with PO=789012. New invoice link: https://invoices.redwood.example/INV-2024-0823-R1.pdf

Jordan (Finance): Recorded CN-2024-110 in ledger (tx ref GL2024-00987). New invoice will go through normal reconciliation. Thanks.

Maya (Support): Sent new invoice + credit confirmation to AcmeCorp. Customer confirmed receipt and that their AP team accepted the new doc. Closing once accounting confirms settlement. :thumbsup:

Liz (Ops): I'll follow up with a postmortem doc to eng-docs explaining template regression and add a pre-deploy unit check to render PO block when metadata.purchase_order is present.

Jordan (Finance): Please add a short line to the vendor-facing KB: "If paid invoice missing PO due to rendering bug, we issue credit note + reissue invoice with PO."

Maya (Support): Noted. Closing thread after final settlement confirmed. Thanks all.

Eli (Payments): FYI for runbook: commands I used and checks to verify metadata present pasted into internal-runbooks/billing-po-fix.md :stripe-charge, PG query, renderer test.

Maya (Support): Marking as resolved in support queue. :white_check_mark:
